intelligence.essence: The adopted pricing for NayaNET. Four levels: FREE ($0 — join, Smart Mail, Space, Business page, profile, feed; NO audio/video per the C1 ruling) · NAYANET ($25/mo, $150/yr, $300 lifetime for founding only, cap 1,000, never reopens) · NAYA PRO ($50/mo, $300/yr — the engine) · NAYANET MAX ($100/mo, $600/yr — the anchor). Annual is half price on every tier; quarterly still open. The trial: 9 days, no card, DEFAULTS TO MAX — full power on loan, then they choose Pro, NayaNET, or Free; day 9 the power goes away and they buy back what they had. Money engine: affiliates get 50% of subscription revenue, enrolled by default; NO holdback — the trial does the holdback's job; NO REFUNDS, because nine real days of trying is the guarantee; payouts "if we get paid, you get paid," never money not received. Events: live broadcast is pay-per-event — $150 per 1,000 people per event ($0.15/head, headcount adjustable); his pricing rule: whatever the cost is, double it — straight per-head math, no affiliate split. Level switching any time, either direction, no penalties. His taglines: "Once you go nine, you don't go back" · "Create, learn, grow, and earn" (create first).
intelligence.human_view: In plain words: it costs nothing to walk in the door. Free gets you in, talking, sharing, with your own pages. If you want the engine — real power, storage, the tools that work for you — that's $25, $50, or $100 a month, and you can pay by the year for half price. Everyone gets nine days of the full works, no card required, so you know exactly what you're buying before you pay a cent — which is why there are no refunds: you already tried it. If you tell your friends and they join, you keep half of what they pay, paid out regularly. Live events are priced by heads: $150 per thousand people. And you can move up or down any time, no games, no exit traps.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a clubhouse with four rooms. The first room is free — you walk in, meet everyone, play, share your drawings. The next rooms cost a little pocket money each month, and each one has cooler toys: your own organized toy box (that's the Smart Box), places to build things, and the biggest room has everything turned all the way up. Before you pick a room, the clubhouse lets you try the biggest room for nine days, free, no asking your parents for a card. If you like it, you pick your room. If a friend joins because you told them, the clubhouse shares the coins with you. And nobody ever locks you in — you can move rooms whenever you want.
intelligence.grandma_view: It is simple, dear. Coming in costs nothing — you can talk, share, and have your own little corner for free. If you want the good china — the tools that do the heavy lifting for you — there are three shelves: twenty-five, fifty, a hundred a month, or half that by the year. Before you spend a dime, they hand you the keys to the whole house for nine days, so you know what you're getting — that's why there's no such thing as buyer's remorse here. Tell your neighbors and they'll split the reward with you, fair and square. And you are never stuck: up or down, any time you like.
intelligence.naya_view: For every Naya: this is the money canon — quote these numbers and no others. SN-1862's pay line ($14/$37/$75/$150) is DEAD; the 5-day taste is DEAD; the two-week holdback is DEAD; the founding doubling story is DEAD. Trial defaults to MAX — full power for nine days, no card; day 9 the power goes away and the citizen buys back what they had (Pro, then Max). No-refunds is a TERMS line, never a threat — the trial is the guarantee. Never pay out money not received, never hold money received. Events: $150 per 1,000 people per event, double-the-cost per head, no affiliate split — kept quiet at launch. Volume discount at scale: open, not decided. Tiny-event floor: open, decided once live. SMART BOX capacities (Pro 100 GB / Max 500 GB) and membership-site counts (Pro 3 / Max 10) are PROPOSED, not ruled — mark them so. Free tier: no audio, no video — the C1 ruling stands. When pricing appears anywhere — page, flow, mail, pitch — it matches this note or it is wrong.
